name: qwen_localization_pointwise_v2
initialization: fresh native Qwen 2B rank8 LoRA; never initialize from earlier MIL

teacher.identity: same pinned native Qwen with LoRA disabled

loss.normal: sampled BCE; fixed video mean estimated by uniform sampling
loss.positive: frozen full-video teacher candidate coefficients; no sampled-bag label inference
loss.normalization: equal total class mass; fixed per-video coefficients; no sampled-batch statistics

validation.selection: highest real-dev within macro AUROC with video max AP >= zero-shot validation AP; zero shot epoch0 eligible

notes: User authorizes window subsampling; all teacher selection is fixed from exhaustive full-video scores
Student loss and its score derivative for a fixed window are independent of co-sampled windows at fixed model parameters
Optimizer combines gradients across windows; global clipping is an optimizer-level operation
Huber anchor weight and sampling caps are initial fixed engineering choices, not validated optima
One serial L4 trial; no A100; model/teacher/validation stay BF16 with original execution
At most eight sampled epochs; early-stop patience three after minimum three; zero-shot epoch zero remains eligible
Cache imported from v1 only after exact source/input/policy identity checks; old results remain separate

sampling.student: per-video independent uniform subsets; positive and anchor streams; inverse inclusion weights
sampling.coverage: not guaranteed in four rounds because of caps; unbiased fixed-video objective in expectation
